title: VPC Egress Watchdog: Terraform operator for automated egress health, routes & upgrades
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a Terraform-native "egress-watchdog" operator module that centralizes VPC egress networking patterns for Private deployments. The module will provision subnets (control/compute/inference), attach NAT Gateways + Internet Gateways where required, create VPC endpoints (S3,ECR,KMS,SSM), and wire route tables with active health-check-driven failover and safe upgrade hooks. The operator should be usable by both managed Private and Dedicated customers to achieve zero-downtime route updates and automated egress path healing when NAT/IGW endpoints fail.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes clear variables for subnet roles, AZ placement, and per-AZ NAT vs centralized NAT choice
Automatic creation of route tables and endpoint routes for S3/ECR that conform to customer isolation settings
Synthetic egress health checks per-AZ with CloudWatch/Datadog metrics and explicit failure thresholds
Automated route failover: on probe failure, routes switch to healthy NAT/egress path with TTL/HA considerations
Upgrade hooks: terraform plan applied in dry-run mode, schema migration steps documented, and a canary apply flag to roll out route changes to a single AZ first
Integration tests (unit/integration) that simulate NAT failure and verify route failover and recovery
Runbooks and oncall playbook committed to repo; alerts wired to oncall channel with remediation hints
Module passes security review for use with private deployments (KMS endpoint pinning + least-privilege IAM policies)
implementation_notes: Design highlights: prefer explicit route objects over implicit replacements to reduce transient blackholes during changes. Use terraform external data + small Lambda-based synthetic probes to publish per-AZ health to a centralized status table (DynamoDB) that feeds routing decisions. Keep the critical data-plane routing changes in Terraform, but allow a controlled automation step (terraform apply with --target route_table_route) triggered by a CI job when the health operator recommends failover. Trade-offs: full runtime route orchestration outside Terraform is faster but reduces single source of truth; we keep Terraform as the canonical source while adding a guarded apply flow to limit blast radius. Support both single-NAT and multi-NAT topologies via variable flags. Document kube-proxy rules for private clusters that rely on egress behavior. Ensure endpoints use policy document templates that allow private S3/ECR access without traversing public internet where customers opt in.
